headline: SILLY CAREERS
chyron: GOVERNMENT LAUNCHES MINISTRY OF SILLY CAREERS
ticker: CAREERCRASH.ORG: PLUMBERS 3, DENTISTS 0, MIME "DECLINED TO COMMENT"
MINISTRY HIRES CONSULTANT TO SILLY-PROOF ITS CONSULTANTS
LIFE COACH COACHES LIFE COACH. LOOP REPORTED
ACCOUNTANTS APPLY TO BE SILLY, ARE DECLINED

beats.text: Tonight: the government opens a Ministry of Silly Careers.
It will fund any job silly enough. Applicants so far: a plumber, a dentist, and a man who fights them both.
That's Career Crash, Philippa. careercrash.org. I've got a dentist on stage twelve.
(walks in. Is trapped in an invisible box.)
Our mime correspondent, Marcel, has the details.
(pulls an invisible rope. Leans on an invisible desk. Bows.)
Marcel, that's the third invisible desk this week. Who's paying for these?
I did not sign off on an invisible desk.
(mimes an invoice. A very long one.)
That's it. I'm getting out of this box!

realStory.text: Made up: there is no Ministry of Silly Careers (the Ministry of Silly Walks first aired in 1970). Career Crash is real: hire a crew of ordinary jobs and watch them brawl at careercrash.org.
